Skill installs a short text that teaches a harness how to use agent: a map
to agent help, not a manual. It is the same text a spawned agent's
briefing starts with, made from the commands agent help lists.

  install  writes it where each harness found on this machine (its CLI on
           PATH, or its config dir) reads skills: Claude Code's
           <config dir>/skills/agent/SKILL.md, also registering gomuxai's
           hook as agent hooks install does, and agy's
           ~/.gemini/config/skills/agent/SKILL.md. --harness picks one.
           A file that already says the same is left as it is.
  show     prints the text.

Usage:
  agent skill [flags]
  agent skill [command]

Examples:
  agent skill install
  agent skill install --harness claude
  agent skill show

Available Commands:
  install     Install the agent skill for every harness here (or one)
  show        Print the agent skill's text

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for skill

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent skill [command] --help" for more information about a command.
